## Not finished — decomposition required before worker dispatch
Role confirmed orchestrator; claimed this Play attempt on main. Claim/setup began 15:28:02 UTC; the five-minute checkpoint at 15:33 UTC had zero independently accepted outcomes. No implementation worker was dispatched because the card's own scope boundary requires concrete decomposition when the complete guarantee does not fit one coherent attempt. No code edits, commits, tests, live runtime scenarios or screenshots were produced. Usage and billed cost are unavailable, not zero.

### Observed source evidence
- resources/skitarii/extension/messaging.ts:512-521 consumes one wake credit before sending constant WAKE_TEXT, not full bodies; failed insertion does not refund it. Its watcher is active only with the running session.
- src/core/services/agentMail.ts:270-292 refuses unarmed mail; read/ack and delivery must remain separate.
- src/main/agents/agentMailDesktop.ts:57-70 and 222-241 monitor/push metadata, with no terminal lifecycle dependency. Stopped peer recipients therefore require a separate lifecycle integration, not merely changing a watcher constant.
- src/main/agents/chatHandlers.ts:451-471 reports delivered on terminals.paste success. src/main/terminals/terminalSessions.ts:168-182 and 1250-1267 say that success only means text is waiting in a running PTY; it is not proof of active-context delivery. Existing paste can resume the existing chat, so do not create replacements.

### Criterion ledger
- c1 unmet: automatic peer idle/busy/stopped wake and independent/burst arrivals are not implemented or proven.
- c2 unmet: no full-body insertion receipt/context-ordering proof; reminder text and PTY queue acceptance are insufficient.
- c3 unmet: no accepted durable progress/receipt protocol or restart/unavailable/no-duplicate-loop evidence. Existing authorization must be preserved.
- c4 unmet: regression changes, complete isolated-card gate, live two-chat proof, inspected screenshot attachments and obsolete UI/docs replacement are absent.

All required checks (lint, typecheck, test, coverage, deadcode, build and Fireguard) are skipped: preflight-only scope recovery, no implementation dispatched. Do not interpret them as passing.

### Concrete recovery DRAFT
Epic ep_01m7wsbhsrd5gdfnvawr75fcg6, title DM-820 recovery: automatic recipient wake and full-context message delivery, branch epic/automatic-message-delivery. Draft revision 2; no saved revision or run. It links the completed communications epic as provenance.
1. Actual worker Node 24/npm/child PATH/native ABI and owned app/capture/live fixtures: GO/NO-GO prerequisite. This shell returned node/npm command not found; their machine-wide absence is NOT established. node_modules exists but is not verified usable. No installations authorized.
2. Authenticated safe-boundary context insertion and durable insertion-receipt/replay semantics: bounded protocol proof; no cognitive-understanding or unsupported exactly-once promise.
3. Durable delivery progress separate from ack/seen, with authorization/reopen regressions.
4. OMP full-body idle/busy delivery, pagination and arrival-during-read tests.
5. Same-chat stopped resume, restart recovery and truthful blockers.
6. Person-board delivery through the proven boundary, preserving supported routing and different trust.
7. Automatic inbox status and obsolete manual control removal, actual available/blocked captures.
8. Accepted-guarantee runbook/injected instructions/changelog.
9. Live two-chat lifecycle/burst/restart scenario with independently inspected context and attached inbox screenshots.
10. Sprint acceptance: full project gate including coverage plus one combined Fireguard, all original DM-820 criteria, no weakened acceptance.

Dependencies: runtime -> protocol -> durable progress -> host insertion; stopped-resume and board integrate the accepted host; inbox consumes resume status; docs and live evidence join at acceptance. One sprint preserves one end-to-end deliverable. Implementation tickets are explicitly provisional until prerequisite evidence validates exact interfaces/schema/caller ownership and dispatch sizing; any change requires draft/Save before claim. The draft is not executable and this session cannot Save. A person must review it and press Save; later prerequisite results may require another draft/Save. Card approval, kick-back and deletion remain human-only.

Recommendation: use this recovery draft rather than pressing Play again on the same oversized unchanged card. No part of ALWAYS was silently narrowed to running/idle recipients.
